caption:
Franz Pro charges $60/year to put all your chats in one app. Ferdium does it for free 💬

✅ Add WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Gmail and more from one list
✅ Add the same service twice to log into two accounts
✅ Workspaces split work from home
✅ A Todo list that stays open beside your chats

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Ferdium is free with no service limit. Franz's free plan stops at 3 services, and its paid plans add extras like AI tools that Ferdium doesn't list
